note: Lime and ají amarillo mashed potato layered with shredded chicken

steps.text: Boil the potatoes, mash smooth with the juice of the limes, the ají amarillo paste, the oil and salt.
Mix the cooked shredded chicken breast with the mayonnaise.
Layer potato, chicken, sliced avocado and more potato in a tin, chill 1 hour and cut into squares.

note: Baked potatoes with butter, cheddar, crisp bacon, sour cream and chives

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Prick the large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake directly on the rack for 60 to 70 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside.
Fry the diced bacon until crisp.
Split the potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork and add the butter.
Top with the grated cheddar and return to the oven for 5 minutes.
Finish with bacon, the sour cream and chives.

note: Frankfurter and mozzarella skewers, battered, fried, then ketchup and mustard

steps.text: Thread the frankfurts onto skewers with a stick of mozzarella above.
Whisk the self-raising flour, the egg, the sugar and the milk into a thick batter, pour into a tall glass, dip each skewer and roll in the panko.
Fry at 170C for 4 minutes, roll in sugar and drizzle with ketchup and mustard.

note: Panko crumbed white fish strips with a lemon dill yoghurt dip

steps.text: Cut the white fish fillets into strips.
Dip in the flour, the beaten eggs and the panko, and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden.
Mix the Greek yoghurt with lemon and chopped dill and serve with lemon wedges.

note: Charred smoked sausage chunks with wholegrain mustard

steps.text: Cook the thick smoked sausages over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred and split.
Cut into chunks and serve on a board with the wholegrain mustard for dipping.

note: Steamed daikon and Chinese sausage cakes, fried crisp, oyster sauce

steps.text: Grate the daikon and simmer in its juice for 10 minutes.
Fry the diced Chinese sausages, the soaked chopped shiitake and the spring onions for 3 minutes.
Mix into the daikon with the rice flour, the water, the salt and the sugar.
Press into an oiled 20cm square tin and steam 45 minutes.
Cool completely, then slice into squares and fry in oil 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Serve with oyster sauce and chilli oil.

note: Panko crumbed sardines fried golden, herby lemon mayo to dip

dish.n: Colony crumbed sardines with lemon mayo

steps.text: Pat the butterflied sardine fillets dry.
Toss in the plain flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then press into the panko mixed with the zest of the lemon and salt.
Shallow fry in 1cm oil over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain.
Mix the mayo with lemon juice, chopped parsley and dill.
Serve hot with the mayo and lemon wedges.

note: Crisp lettuce wedges with blue cheese dressing, bacon and tomato

steps.text: Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with lemon and pepper.
Fry the rashers bacon until crisp and crumble.
Spoon the dressing over the wedges and scatter with bacon and the diced tomato.

note: Coconut chicken laksa with tofu puffs, rice noodles and bean sprouts

steps.text: Fry the laksa paste for 2 minutes, add the coconut milk and the water and simmer.
Add the sliced chicken thighs and cook 8 minutes, then the tofu puffs.
Divide the cooked rice noodles into bowls, ladle over the laksa and top with bean sprouts.

note: Fresh rolls of prawn, mango, cucumber and rice vermicelli

dish.n: Darwin mango and prawn rice paper rolls

steps.text: Soak the rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool.
Peel and halve the cooked prawns.
Slice the mangoes and the cucumber into strips.
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat, add prawns, mango, cucumber, noodles, mint and Vietnamese mint and roll tightly.
Repeat until all the rolls are made.
Mix the fish sauce, the lime juice, the sugar, the water, the chopped chilli and the garlic clove.

note: Salami, kabana, dill pickles, cream cheese and sliced dark rye

steps.text: Slice the salami and the kabana and lay them out on a big board.
Add the dill pickles cut into spears, the cream cheese in a bowl and a sliced dark rye loaf, the way Magda would set out a New Year's Eve spread.

note: Baked feta with olives, figs, oregano and chilli, crusty bread

dish.n: Macrinus's baked feta with figs and honey

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Put the block of feta in a small baking dish with the mixed olives around it.
Halve the fresh figs and nestle them in.
Drizzle with the olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano, chilli flakes and thyme sprigs.
Bake 15 minutes until the feta is soft.
Drizzle with the honey and serve with torn crusty bread.

note: Slow-cooked onion, sour cream and cream cheese dip with kettle chips

dish.n: Laurel's caramelised onion dip with chips

steps.text: Slowly cook the thinly sliced onions in the butter and the oil over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until deep brown.
Add the balsamic and cool.
Chop roughly and mix with the sour cream, the soft cream cheese, the Worcestershire, the chives, salt and pepper.
Chill 1 hour.
Serve with the salted kettle chips and celery sticks.

note: Floured fried wings tossed in a honey, sriracha and soy glaze

steps.text: Toss the chicken wings in the flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Fry at 175C for 10 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Simmer the honey, the sriracha and the soy until glossy and toss the wings through.

note: Panko crumbed white fish bites with lemon and tartare sauce

steps.text: Cut the white fish into bite-size pieces.
Roll in the flour, the beaten eggs, then the panko and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and the tartare sauce.

note: Warm dark chocolate and cream fondue for dipping strawberries

steps.text: Melt the dark chocolate with the cream and a pinch of salt over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Pour into a warm bowl and serve with the strawberries, the marshmallows and a cut-up sponge cake for dipping.

note: Garlic and chilli prawns grilled hot, piled on ice with lime

steps.text: Toss the peeled green prawns with the olive oil, the garlic cloves, the chopped red chilli and salt.
Grill on high for 2 minutes a side.
Pile over a platter of crushed ice and serve with lime wedges.

note: Grilled hot dogs with spiced beef chilli sauce, mustard and onion

steps.text: Brown the beef mince until very fine and dry, then add the chilli powder, the cumin, the paprika and the water and cook 10 minutes.
Grill the frankfurts and put in the hot dog buns with mustard, the coney sauce and diced onion.

note: Coconut crumbed prawns, fried golden, with mango chilli sauce

steps.text: Peel the green king prawns, leaving tails on.
Dust in the plain flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then press into the desiccated coconut mixed with the panko.
Fry in oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and drain.
Simmer the flesh of the mango with the sweet chilli sauce, the juice of the lime and the chopped red chilli for 3 minutes, then blitz smooth.
Serve the prawns hot with the sauce.

note: Mini bagels with caper dill cream cheese, smoked salmon, pickled onion

dish.n: Desk pop smoked salmon bagel bites

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and cover with the white vinegar, the sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese with the chopped capers, the chopped dill and lemon zest.
Split and toast 8 mini bagels.
Spread each half with the cream cheese, fold on smoked salmon, top with drained pickled onion and dill and grind over pepper.

note: Crispy chicken thigh in a sticky orange ginger sauce, sesame on top

steps.text: Cut the chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces, toss with the soy, then in the cornflour.
Fry in batches in oil at 180C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp.
Simmer the juice of the oranges with the zest of one of them, the soy, the honey, the rice vinegar, the grated ginger and the garlic clove for 5 minutes, then thicken with the cornflour in water.
Toss the chicken through and top with sesame and spring onion.

note: Mini cheeseburgers with dill pickles on slider buns

steps.text: Shape the beef mince into small patties and season.
Cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding half a cheese slice each at the end.
Put in the slider buns with pickles and sauce.

note: Pan-toasted leg ham and cheddar sandwiches, cut into triangles

steps.text: Butter the outsides of the slices of bread and fill the sandwiches with the ham and the grated cheddar.
Cook in a pan over medium heat for exactly 3 minutes a side and cut into neat triangles.

film: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga (2020)
note: Grilled franks with raw and crispy onions, sweet mustard and remoulade

steps.text: Grill the frankfurts.
Put in the hot dog buns with diced raw onion, the crispy fried onions, sweet mustard and the remoulade or tartare.
Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

film: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga (2020)
note: Rye crispbread with crème fraîche, smoked trout, pickled cucumber, dill

steps.text: Spread the rye crispbreads with the crème fraîche.
Top with the flaked smoked trout, thin pickled cucumber and dill.
Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

note: Corn chips under spiced beef and melted cheese

steps.text: Brown the beef mince with taco seasoning.
Spread the corn chips on a tray, top with the beef and the grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes.
Finish with salsa and the sour cream.

note: Crisp baked wings in hot sauce butter, ranch for dipping

steps.text: Bake the chicken wings tossed with the baking powder and salt at 220C for 45 minutes.
Toss in the hot sauce melted with the butter and serve with the ranch.

note: Warm blinis with chive crème fraîche and salmon roe

steps.text: Warm the small blinis at 180C for 4 minutes.
Mix the crème fraîche with the chopped chives and lemon zest.
Top each blini with a spoon of the cream, a ribbon of smoked salmon and half a teaspoon of salmon roe.
Finish with a tiny dill sprig and a squeeze of lemon and arrange on a platter.

note: Slow-cooked onion and sour cream dip with potato chips

dish.n: From-scratch French onion dip and chips

steps.text: Slowly cook the thinly sliced onions in the butter for 25 minutes until deep golden.
Cool and chop.
Mix with the sour cream, the mayo, a little garlic powder, the Worcestershire, the chopped chives, salt and pepper.
Chill 1 hour so the flavours settle.
Serve with the thick-cut salted potato chips.

note: Soft pretzel bites with a warm lager cheddar sauce

dish.n: Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C.
Roll the pizza dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites.
Simmer the water with the bicarb soda and dip the bites for 15 seconds.
Drain, place on lined trays, brush with egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and the lager, then the grated cheddar and the mustard until smooth.

note: Crisp fries under cheddar sauce, bacon, pickled jalapeño, sour cream

steps.text: Bake the frozen thick-cut fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Fry the diced bacon until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in the grated cheddar until smooth.
Pile the fries on a platter, pour over the cheese sauce and top with bacon, sliced pickled jalapeños and spring onion.
Serve with the sour cream.

note: Buttermilk pancakes with crisp bacon, whipped butter and maple syrup

steps.text: Whisk the self-raising flour, the sugar, the eggs, the buttermilk and the melted butter into a thick batter.
Grill the bacon rashers until crisp.
Cook ladles of batter in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden and risen.
Beat the soft butter until fluffy.
Stack the pancakes per plate with bacon and a spoon of butter, and pour over warm maple syrup.

note: Big soft pretzels with wholegrain mustard butter and vinegar radishes

dish.n: Wolfhouse giant pretzels with mustard butter

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C.
Divide the pizza dough into equal pieces and roll into 80cm ropes.
Twist into pretzel shapes.
Simmer the water with the bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds.
Lay on lined trays, brush with egg, scatter with rock salt and bake 15 to 18 minutes until deep brown.
Beat the soft butter with the wholegrain mustard and the honey.
Serve with sliced radishes tossed in vinegar and salt.

note: Baked black bean dip with cheddar, salsa, sour cream and corn chips

dish.n: Cool beans loaded black bean dip

steps.text: Fry the diced onion and the garlic cloves in oil for 5 minutes, add the cumin and the smoked paprika, then the drained tins black beans and the water.
Simmer 5 minutes and mash roughly with lime juice and salt.
Spread in a baking dish, cover with the grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 10 minutes.
Top with the salsa, the sour cream, sliced jalapeño and coriander.
Serve with the corn chips.

note: Grilled franks in buns under beef chilli and melted cheddar

steps.text: Brown the beef mince with the diced onion.
Add the chilli powder, the cumin, the tomato paste, the passata and the water and simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Grill the frankfurts until blistered.
Toast the hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over the chilli and top with the grated cheddar.
Grill 1 minute to melt, then finish with diced white onion and yellow mustard.

note: Toasted marshmallow, milk chocolate and salted caramel between biscuits

steps.text: Make the caramel: melt the sugar until amber, whisk in the cream and the butter, then a little salt and cool.
Lay the digestive or wheatmeal biscuits on a board and top them with a square of milk chocolate.
Toast the large marshmallows on skewers over a fire or gas flame until golden.
Push the onto each chocolate biscuit, spoon over caramel and squash with a second biscuit.

note: Garlic rosemary drumsticks glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Rub the chicken drumsticks with the oil, the crushed garlic cloves, the chopped rosemary, the smoked paprika and salt.
Roast on a lined tray for 35 minutes.
Mix the honey and the wholegrain mustard, brush over and roast 10 minutes more until sticky.
Wrap the bones in baking paper and serve on a board.

note: Crisp baked wings in a sticky honey soy glaze

dish.n: Sturdy Wings honey soy chicken wings

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss the chicken wings with the baking powder and the salt and bake on a rack for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Simmer the honey, the soy, the crushed garlic cloves, the grated ginger and the rice vinegar for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the wings in the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.

note: Beer-battered fish, slaw, pickled onion and chipotle mayo in tortillas

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.
Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage with lime and salt.
Mix the mayo with the chipotle in adobo.
Whisk the flour, the baking powder and the cold beer.
Cut the white fish into strips, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, onion, mayo and coriander.

note: Corn chips with pulled pork, black beans, cheddar and lime sour cream

steps.text: Toss the pulled pork with the barbecue sauce.
Spread the corn chips on a big tray and scatter with the pork, the drained black beans and the grated cheddar.
Bake at 200C for 10 minutes until melted.
Mix the sour cream with the juice of the lime and drizzle over.
Top with sliced pickled jalapeños, diced tomato, coriander and spring onion.

note: Corn chips with chorizo, beans, cheddar, guacamole and sour cream

steps.text: Fry the diced chorizo until crisp.
Warm the refried beans with the cumin.
Spread the corn chips on a big tray, spoon over the beans and chorizo and cover with the grated cheddar.
Bake at 200C for 10 minutes.
Mash the avocados with lime, salt and coriander.
Top the nachos with guacamole, the sour cream, pickled jalapeños and spring onion.

note: Crispy chicken bites soaked in dill pickle brine, pickle ranch dip

steps.text: Cut the chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces and soak in the dill pickle brine for 2 hours.
Drain, dip in the beaten egg with the buttermilk, then the plain flour mixed with the paprika and salt.
Fry at 175C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and toss with dried dill and salt.
Mix the sour cream, the mayo, the chopped pickles and dill for dipping.

note: Chorizo and jalapeño cheese dip served hot with corn chips and peanuts

dish.n: Smart Tech poker night queso dip

steps.text: Fry the diced chorizo until crisp.
Add half a diced onion and the chopped jalapeño for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cornflour, then the evaporated milk, and simmer until it thickens.
Over low heat, stir in the grated cheddar a handful at a time until smooth, then the chopped roasted capsicum and a pinch of cumin.
Serve hot in a skillet with the corn chips and the salted peanuts.

note: Melted gruyère and emmental in white wine, with bread for dipping

steps.text: Rub a heavy pot with a halved garlic clove.
Heat the dry white wine until just simmering.
Toss the grated gruyère and the grated emmental with the cornflour and add a handful at a time, stirring in a figure eight until smooth.
Stir in the kirsch or lemon juice and nutmeg.
Keep warm over a burner and serve with the cubed baguette, the boiled baby potatoes and cornichons.

note: Spiral pizza dough rolls with pepperoni and mozzarella, marinara to dip

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Roll the pizza dough into a 30 x 40cm rectangle.
Spread with the pizza sauce and scatter the sliced pepperoni and the grated mozzarella.
Roll up from the long side and cut into slices.
Place in a lined tin, bake 20 to 25 minutes and brush with the butter melted with the garlic clove.
Warm the marinara for dipping.

film: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004)
note: Crinkle-cut chips with mozzarella and hot beef gravy

dish.n: Jersey gravy fries with melted cheese

steps.text: Bake the frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the beef stock and the Worcestershire and simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Pile the chips onto a tray, scatter with the grated mozzarella and grill 2 minutes until melted.
Pour over the hot gravy and top with pepper and sliced spring onion.

film: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004)
note: Dill pickle spears in a polenta crumb, fried, with herb sour cream

steps.text: Pat the dill pickle spears very dry.
Whisk the egg and the buttermilk.
Mix the plain flour, the fine polenta, the smoked paprika and salt.
Dip the spears in buttermilk, then the flour mix.
Fry at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and drain.
Mix the sour cream, the buttermilk, the mayo, chopped dill, chives and a crushed garlic clove for dipping.

note: Crisp rolls of pork mince, cabbage and carrot in oyster sauce

dish.n: Sweet and Dude pork spring rolls

steps.text: Fry the pork mince until browned, add the finely shredded cabbage, the grated carrot, the crushed garlic cloves, the oyster sauce and the soy, and cook 3 minutes.
Cool completely.
Roll the filling in each of the spring roll wrappers, sealing the edge with a little water.
Deep fry at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden, then drain on paper towel.
Stir the juice of the lime into the sweet chilli sauce and serve with coriander.

note: Crisp chips under beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar, sour cream

steps.text: Bake the frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Meanwhile brown the beef mince with the diced onion, add the smoked paprika, the ground cumin, the chilli powder, the crushed tomatoes and the drained kidney beans, and simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Pile the chips into a baking dish, spoon over the chilli, scatter with the grated cheddar and grill 3 minutes until melted.
Top with the sour cream, sliced jalapeños and spring onion.

note: Cocktail franks in puff pastry, honey mustard dip

steps.text: Cut the thawed puff pastry into strips.
Brush each strip with a little Dijon mustard and wrap around the cocktail frankfurts.
Lay seam-side down on a lined tray, brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.
Stir the wholegrain mustard into the honey and the mayonnaise for dipping and serve warm.

note: Tortilla rolls with ham, cheddar, spinach and mustard cream cheese

dish.n: Grade one ham and cheese pinwheels
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep rolled and chilled

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese and mustard until smooth, then spread thinly over the tortillas right to the edges.
Layer ham, spinach and grated cheddar over each tortilla.
Roll up tightly and wrap in cling film.
Chill so the rolls hold their shape.
Trim the ends, cut each roll into pinwheels and serve with cherry tomatoes and cornichons.

note: Triple-decker toast with chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Grill the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Build each sandwich with toast, chicken, lettuce and tomato, then toast, bacon and lettuce, then the last slice of toast.
Press down gently, pin with toothpicks, trim the crusts and cut into squares. Serve with crisps.

note: Cajun spiced prawns swirled in garlic butter, with baguette

steps.text: Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with the Cajun seasoning.
Sear the prawns in a very hot pan with oil in a single layer, turning once.
Drop the heat, add the butter and garlic and swirl until foaming.
Squeeze over the lemon, scatter with parsley and serve from the pan with the baguette.

note: Cream cheese and vintage cheddar ball with chives and Worcestershire

dish.n: Grandma's cheddar and chive cheese ball
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, Worcestershire, garlic powder and most of the chives until smooth.
Shape into a ball and wrap in cling film. Chill until firm.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan, chop finely and mix with the remaining chives.
Roll the cheese ball in the nuts and serve with crackers and celery.

note: Rolled pizza dough with pepperoni and mozzarella, marinara to dunk

steps.text: Roll the dough on a floured bench into a large rectangle.
Spread with pizza sauce and scatter with pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano.
Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack into a greased 24cm tin.
Brush with the melted butter and garlic, then bake at 200C until golden.
Warm the marinara and serve for dunking.

film: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)
note: Halved boiled eggs filled with creamy yolk mayo and crisp bacon

steps.text: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook, then cool in iced water and peel.
Halve the eggs and scoop out the yolks. Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and salt until smooth.
Grill the bacon until crisp and crumble finely.
Spoon the yolk mix back into the whites, dust with paprika and top with bacon and chives.

film: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)
note: Cheddar, pineapple, cabana and onion on picks stuck in a rockmelon

steps.text: Cut the rockmelon into pieces and place one piece cut-side down on a platter as the body, with cloves for eyes.
Cut the cheddar and pineapple into cubes and slice the cabana into rounds.
Thread toothpicks with cheese, pineapple and either a cocktail onion or cabana.
Push them all over the rockmelon until covered in spikes.

note: Crisp fried triangles of curried beef, carrot and peas, mint yoghurt

dish.n: Safari camp beef samosas with mint yoghurt
dish.make_ahead: Filled samosas up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the mince, onion and garlic until browned. Add the curry powder, garam masala, carrot and peas and cook, then stir through the coriander and cool.
Cut the wrappers into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles, sealing with water.
Fry at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Mix the yoghurt with the mint and a pinch of salt for dipping.
Serve the samosas hot with the mint yoghurt.

note: Steamed pork and ginger dumplings with fresh chilli tomato sauce

dish.n: Monastery momos with chilli tomato sauce

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 2 crushed for the filling and 1 for the sauce

steps.text: Mix the pork with the ginger, two of the garlic cloves, spring onions, soy and sesame oil.
Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edges and pleat closed.
Steam in a lined steamer over boiling water.
Blitz the tomatoes, chillies, remaining garlic, salt and vinegar, then simmer to make the sauce.

note: Buttermilk fried chicken tenders on small soft buns

steps.text: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with salt.
Toss the chicken in the flour mixed with paprika and garlic powder.
Shallow fry at 180C, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha. Toss the cabbage with the vinegar.
Toast the buns and fill with chicken, slaw, pickles and sriracha mayo.

note: Mixed nuts roasted with honey, chilli, paprika and rosemary, plus jerky

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Toss the nuts with the honey, oil, chilli, paprika and rosemary.
Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C, stirring twice, until golden.
Sprinkle with sea salt while hot and cool so the coating crisps.
Serve in a bowl next to the sliced jerky.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer. Rub a lime wedge around each glass rim and dip into the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, a couple of dashes of hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire to each.
Top each with a bottle of cold lager, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge.

note: Fried ham and gruyère sandwiches under bubbling béchamel, cut in fingers

dish.n: Cat lady cover croque monsieur bites

steps.text: Melt some of the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Season with nutmeg and stir in a little gruyere.
Spread the bread thinly with Dijon and make sandwiches with ham and gruyere.
Fry the sandwiches in butter on both sides.
Spread the bechamel on top, scatter with more gruyere and grill until bubbling.
Cut into fingers and serve with cornichons.

note: Creamy clam chowder with bacon and potato, oyster crackers on the side

dish.n: Boston clam chowder with oyster crackers

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp, then add the onion and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the flour, then the fish stock and potato. Simmer until the potato is tender.
Add the clams, cover and cook until open, then pick out the empty shells.
Stir in the cream and heat through. Season with pepper and serve with oyster crackers and chives.

note: Crisp baked wings in hot sauce butter, blue cheese dip and celery

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Mash the blue cheese with the sour cream, mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon for the dip.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through it. Serve with the dip and celery.

note: Corn chips with spiced beef, black beans, cheddar, guacamole and salsa

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion. Add the spices, tomato paste and a splash of water and simmer. Stir in the black beans.
Layer the corn chips in a baking dish with the beef and cheddar.
Bake at 200C until the cheese melts.
Mash the avocados with lime and salt.
Top with guacamole, sour cream, salsa and jalapenos.

note: Panko crumbed crab cakes with lemon and chipotle mayo

dish.n: My name is Jeff crab cakes

steps.text: Mix the crab with some of the mayonnaise, egg, spring onions, lemon zest, mustard and half the panko.
Shape into small cakes and chill.
Roll the cakes in the remaining panko.
Fry in oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Mix the remaining mayonnaise with the chipotle and a squeeze of lime. Serve with lime wedges.

note: Crisp baked wings tossed in sticky barbecue sauce

steps.text: Toss the wings with the baking powder, paprika and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey, soy and vinegar until sticky.
Toss the hot wings in the glaze and return to the oven.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.

note: Pork, apple and fennel sausage rolls in puff pastry

dish.n: Frat party pork and fennel sausage rolls

steps.text: Mix the sausage mince with the apple, onion, fennel, breadcrumbs and pepper.
Cut the pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut each roll into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Stir the paprika into the relish and serve alongside.

note: Marshmallow nougat, soft caramel and milk chocolate, cut into bars

dish.n: The last chocolate caramel nougat bar

steps.text: Melt the marshmallows with the butter, stir in the malted milk powder and vanilla, and press into a lined 20cm square tin.
Melt the caramels with the cream until smooth and spread over the nougat.
Chill.
Melt the chocolate with the oil and pour over the top.
Chill until set, then cut into bars with a hot knife.

note: Pretzels, corn chips, crackers and peanuts baked in ranch butter

dish.n: Ranch pretzel and peanut snack mix
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Melt the butter with the Worcestershire, ranch seasoning, paprika and garlic powder.
Toss with the pretzels, corn chips, crackers and peanuts in a large roasting tin.
Bake at 150C, stirring every ten minutes.
Cool on the tray so it crisps, then tip into a very big bowl.

note: Chicken salted chips with bacon and melted cheese sauce

dish.n: Future cheese fries with chicken salt

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp, then toss with chicken salt.
Grill the bacon until crisp and chop.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in the cheddar and mustard until smooth.
Pile the chips on a platter, pour over the cheese sauce and scatter with bacon and spring onion.

note: Puff pastry spirals with sundried tomato pesto, ham, basil and cheese

dish.n: Greeting card cheese and tomato pinwheels

steps.text: Lay the pastry flat and spread with the pesto. Top with ham, basil and cheese.
Roll up tightly and chill.
Cut each roll into slices and lay cut-side down on a lined tray. Brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
